Why We Built Statue

We built Statue because we needed it ourselves. When you start building something new, your website is the first thing you need, but getting from "I want a site" to actually having one live on a domain you own involves way too many services and configurations. 

We wanted a tool that just worked. Statue is that tool. Write your content in Markdown, and you get a fast static site. No configuration maze, no vendor lock-in, no spending a week learning six different platforms before you can publish a single page.
